CREATE TABLE device_type ( code VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, category_code VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT pk_device_type_code PRIMARY KEY (code), CONSTRAINT fk_category_code_to_device_type FOREIGN KEY (category_code) REFERENCES device_category (code) );
